name: edunex-plus
description: Unofficial, community-built desktop client for ITB's EduNex LMS

scripts.dev: npm run build:node && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:node && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-packager . --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.icns && node scripts/adhoc-sign-electron.mjs "Edunex Plus-darwin-arm64/Edunex Plus.app"
